path_law.extension: if gamma ends at C and has length j<J, extend gamma by every D in FAR(C)
path_law.strict_rule: FAR_PLUS is used equivalently because FAR=FAR_PLUS globally

outputs.END_J(seedset): all terminal cells of exact-J escape paths from any seed
outputs.REACH_LE_J(seedset): union of endpoint sets at all jump counts 0..J
outputs.path_multiplicity: recorded as provenance only; never used to delete an endpoint

structural_consequence: because every escape edge raises SHELL by exactly one, every exact-J path is a geodesic continuation away from STAR(O_E), and every strictly shell-increasing dual-graph path is an admissible escape path
